## About
I'm Mark Gebhard, owner of Gebhard's Cycles. I don't just repair and maintain bikes, I ride them too, so I know how important yours is to you. From the time your bike comes into my shop until it leaves, I treat it with as much respect and care as I would my own.
You'll find the shop on Old Haddonfield Road in Pennsauken, next to where the Pennsauken Mart used to be. Whether you need repairs, parts installed or custom pinstriping, come on by and I'll get you taken care of right.

## Services
- Repair and maintenance: Fluid changes, tune ups and carb cleanings to keep your bike running smooth.
- Engine and transmission rebuilds: Rebuild work on engines and transmissions, done in the shop.
- Tire mounting and balancing: Tires mounted and balanced. One reviewer said Mark was prompt and fairly priced on a tire change.
- Parts ordering and installation: Add parts for a personal touch or a boost in performance, and I'll order and install them.
- Custom paint: Custom paint work to give your bike a look that's all yours.
- Custom pin striping: Pin striping to personalize a bike or vehicle that's special to you, or to accent its body lines.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of bikes do you work on?
A: All domestic and imported bikes, including Harley Davidson, Victory, Honda, Kawasaki, Suzuki, Yamaha, BMW, Ducati and more. I'm also a Bigdog Motorcycles and custom chopper specialist.

Q: What if I can't bring my bike in?
A: Give me a call. I can arrange pick up and delivery for bikes I work on.

Q: Do you charge for a quote?
A: Ride-in quotes are no cost. Call to set up an appointment for a price quote.

Q: Can I drop my bike off outside regular hours?
A: If you call ahead, I can open the shop early or late for drop-offs.
